# MCT2 - Phototransistor optocoupler (GaAs infrared LED + NPN phototransistor)

Package DIP-6 · family opto · catalogue file [catalog/chips/MCT2.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/MCT2.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 55 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![MCT2 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/MCT2.png) | ![MCT2 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-MCT2.png) | ![MCT2 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-MCT2.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Details |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | ANODE | analog | infrared LED anode |
| 2 | CATHODE | analog | infrared LED cathode |
| 3 | NC | nc |  |
| 4 | EMITTER | analog | phototransistor emitter |
| 5 | COLLECTOR | analog | phototransistor collector |
| 6 | BASE | analog | phototransistor base |

## Functions

| Output pin | What it does |
|---|---|
| 5 | Current through the LED (pins 1 to 2) turns the phototransistor on: collector current is at least 20% of the LED current (CTR min 20% at IF 10 mA, VCE 10 V). LED forward voltage 1.25 V typ, 1.50 V max at 20 mA. VCE(sat) 0.4 V max at IC 2 mA, IF 16 mA. No LED current: collector dark current 50 nA max at VCE 10 V. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputMaxVoltageV | 30 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Limits, not recommended conditions: LED IF 100 mA max, VR 3 V; collector current 50 mA max; VCEO 30 V; BVCBO 70 V min; BVECO 7 V min. outputMaxVoltageV = VCEO. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IF | COLLECTOR | turnOn | 1100 | IF 15 mA, VCC 5 V, RL 2 k, RB open |
| IF | COLLECTOR | turnOff | 50000 | IF 15 mA, VCC 5 V, RL 2 k, RB open |
| IF | COLLECTOR | turnOn | 1300 | IF 20 mA, VCC 5 V, RL 2 k, RB 100 k |
| IF | COLLECTOR | turnOff | 20000 | IF 20 mA, VCC 5 V, RL 2 k, RB 100 k |

## Not known

- The only datasheet found is a 2003 Fairchild sheet; no 1970s original (Monsanto/GI/Motorola) was found. Figures may differ from the parts ND used.
- Switching times are typical only (the column could be typ; the sheet prints one number per row).
- Minimum CTR read as 20% from the MCT2/MCT2E row; the text layer of that table is out of order.

## Notes

Times are in ns (1.1 us = 1100 ns).

## Sources

- [Fairchild Semiconductor MCT2/MCT2E/MCT210/MCT271/MCT2200/MCT2201/MCT2202 phototransistor optocouplers, 10/10/03](https://www.komponenten.es.aau.dk/fileadmin/komponenten/Data_Sheet/Opto/MCT2.pdf) - 1-4; MCT2 (non -M, black package)

## Used on sheets

No sheet in this repository uses this chip yet.
